pixel_convention: x to the right, y downwards, origin top-left pixel; all lengths in pixels

duplicate_frames.note: frames 1, 26, 51 are pixel-identical (mean abs diff < 0.05) to frames 0, 25, 50; per-frame displacement there is 0 and the following step is doubled. The trackers copy the previous row for these frames (duplicate_frame=1).

camera.motion: static (phase correlation on the rock outcrop and on sand: shift < 0.05 px over all 75 frames)
camera.view: high-angle, nearly top-down aerial view over a beach; no horizon or sky visible. Upright things (person, boat mast) appear as short upward strokes in the image (head drawn above feet, mast top above its base), so image-up corresponds roughly to 'away from camera' on the ground / world up. Ground plane ~ image plane with mild perspective.
camera.apparent_size_change: person bbox width constant 27-29 px while moving from y=549 to y=705; boat hull main-axis length 490-512 px constant while moving ~560 px; bird size varies with wing pose (45-90 px main axis) not with depth trend. => no measurable depth change of any object over the clip in the image; use depth_info if given.

objects.name: person
objects.description: man in white T-shirt and grey/blue jeans, brown hair, on the dry sand left of image centre, with a long dark shadow pointing up-right
objects.motion: walks slowly 'down' the image (toward the water / camera-near side), ~2.0 px/frame, path from (512,549) at f0 to (524,705) at f74 (mask centroid); walking cycle visible (legs alternate)
objects.reference_point: mask centroid (falls at the shirt hem / belt line = pelvis region)

pixel_size.note: image 'height' is head-top to feet-bottom of the foreshortened upright figure; varies with stride; feet partly inside his shadow so bottom +-4 px

objects.name: bird
objects.description: large black/dark-brown bird of prey flying left to right across the frame, above the beach then over the water
objects.motion: enters at left edge at f2 (x=0,y~513), passes just below the person's feet at f24-26, crosses the shoreline ~f46-50, leaves at right edge after f70 (x~1530,y~935); ~24 px/frame, nearly constant; slight downward curve
objects.reference_point: mask centroid (wings flap, so centroid jitters a few px with pose)

pixel_size.note: wingspan direction is roughly vertical in the image (wings drawn up/down, bird flies right); the max main-axis length ~ the wingspan when spread (largest ~88-91 px at f56-58, ~75-77 at f32-35)

objects.name: bird_shadow
objects.description: blurry dark shadow of the bird on the sand, ~450-600 px up-right of the bird, moves with it
objects.note: crosses the person's shadow f7-23 (merged), fades over wet sand/water from f31; low reliability

objects.name: boat
objects.description: small fishing boat: red hull, white deck and white cabin with red roof, mast with white cross-trees, green hatch, registration text on hull side; bow to the upper-left, stern to the lower-right; dark shadow on the water to its right
objects.partly_out_of_frame: f0 (stern touches bottom edge), f66-74 (bow cut by left edge)
objects.motion: translates bow-first toward the upper-left along its own axis, ~8.2 px/frame (full-mask centroid (743,1414) f0 -> (188,1259) f74); hull axis stays at ~20.5 deg (image, bow up-left), no rotation
objects.reference_point: full-mask centroid (cx,cy); hull-only centroid (hull_cx,hull_cy, mast/rails removed) also given — the hull centre is the better proxy for the root

pixel_size.mast_height_px_approx: mast top ~115-150 px above the cabin roof in the image

objects.name: person_shadow
objects.description: long dark shadow of the person on the sand, from the feet up-right ~120 px
objects.note: moves with the person; not tracked separately

objects.name: rock_outcrop
objects.description: large rocky/boulder area at the top right, whitish top and dark brown rocks, cut by the top image edge

objects.name: sand_beach
objects.description: smooth pink-beige sand filling the upper ~2/3; a lighter dry-sand plateau with a jagged lower edge (lowest tip ~(570,1030)), then a darker wet-sand band; the wet sand/water line reaches its lowest point at ~(647,1159)

objects.name: water
objects.description: green/teal water in the lower part and along the right side; boat floats in it

events.event: clip start: person already walking, boat already moving, bird off-frame (its shadow visible)
bird enters frame at left edge
bird passes closest to the person (just below his feet, image-adjacent, no contact visible)
bird crosses from sand over the wet-sand/water edge
boat bow reaches the left image edge (full mask x0=0 at f66, hull x0=0 at f67); from here the boat centroids are biased (truncated) - use the stern-side x1 for motion
bird starts leaving at right edge
clip end: person still walking, boat still moving
